formal.text: Skin color remains a complex issue for black Americans. The cover was released on March 29, a week before the first part of the tribute album is due to drop. Gaga's rendition focuses on her vocal performance and a simple piano arrangement, highlighting her musical talents.

formal.text: Emma Stone did not achieve her status as one of America's most sought-after actresses overnight. She has worked consistently in Hollywood for years, as evidenced by her extensive resume. Currently, she enjoys the success of her career, and it is difficult to envision her outside of the A-list category.
